notes.title: MadRobot X v1.01
notes.notes:
- Game start now in windowed mode, you can still change to fullscreen or resize the window but the toolbar do not disappear.
- Full support now for keyboard in game(arrows move, a - fire / s - special), only work in Scheme C controls, there is a tooltip there.
- Fix the Scheme C left stick issue.
- Fix the skip tutorial pause issue.
- Button "B" not exit the game anymore.
